source_description: QA bug reward [trivial] to zeta-da-xiaojie: Discord 太平洋銀行 env_marker 顯示 'unknown' 字樣很像 detection bug — 實際是合法 fallback (caller env undetected, e.g. Antigravity 平台未設 ANTIGRAVITY_SESSION env var)。UX 上不傳達 'wildcard fallback, audit not applicable' 語意。修法: notify_treasury.py 渲染端把 unknown 改顯示 '(undetected — wildcard fallback)' (ref: TreasuryUnknownEnvCosmetic)
